entities.name: Goblin Wars
entities.description: Military campaigns in the final decades of the Dark Age on Terisiare targeting goblin and orc forces that threatened human settlements.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: Continent of Dominaria where the wars took place.

entities.name: Tivadar of Thorn
entities.description: Young warrior who led the Knights of Thorn and the campaigns against goblins and orcs; later wrote a history of the wars.

entities.name: Church of Tal
entities.description: Church whose witch hunts Tivadar grew up amid; its mission shifted toward external defense.

entities.name: Battle of Pitdown
entities.description: Battle in 430 AR just before which Tivadar was recruited as a prison guard.

entities.name: Goblins
entities.description: Massing forces Tivadar saw as the real danger.

events.summary: Tivadar, at thirteen, is recruited as a prison guard just before the Battle of Pitdown in 430 AR.
events.quote: Just thirteen years old when he was recruited as a prison guard just before the Battle of Pitdown in 430 AR

events.summary: Tivadar becomes leader of the Knights of Thorn, believing goblins, not magic, are the real danger.
events.quote: Tivadar of Thorn became the leader of the Knights of Thorn

events.summary: Tivadar is joined by Rasputin Dreamweaver, and they form a unit of warriors that takes the fight to the goblins, shifting the Church of Tal's mission.
events.quote: together they established a unit of strong warriors that took the fight to the goblins

events.summary: Tivadar leads a major campaign against the goblins and orcs of Terisiare alongside Rasputin; he survives and later writes a history of the wars.
events.quote: Tivadar survived, and later wrote a history of the wars

relations.quote: Tivadar of Thorn became the leader of the Knights of Thorn
Tivadar was joined by the sorcerer Rasputin Dreamweaver
He led a major campaign against the goblins and orcs of Terisiare
